  1                                 PERSONAL INFORMATION:

 2   Q. Please state your name and address.

 3   A. My name is Tracy Snell Mack.

 4   My address is 250 Richards Drive, Buda, Texas 78610.

 5   Q. Have you filed a Motion to Intervene in this proceeding?

 6   A. Yes.

 7   Q. What link and tracts are you testifying in representation of today?

 8   A. Link U1, Tract 5056.9.

 9   Q. Are you testifying on behalf of anyone, or just yourself?

10   A. I am testifying on behalf of myself, Tracy Snell Mack, TTEE of the M. A. Snell

11   Investments Trust.

12   Q. How is the property affected by the Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV

13   transmission line project proposed by Oncor and LCRA TSC?

14   A. Our property is adjacent to the link U1 proposed route.

15   Q. What is the purpose of your testimony?

16   A. I am in opposition of any and all routes that include Link U1.

17

18

19
                                                                Direct Testimony of Tracy Snell Mack
                                                                             PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                        Page 4 of 12
  1   Q. What routes do you oppose?

 2   A. I oppose any and all (24) routes that include Link U1 such as the following: 74, 84,

 3   93, 100, 389, 391, 392, 399, 402, 408, 410, 416, 420, 425, 427, 429, 430, 441, 442,

 4   453, 462, 588, 589, 592.

 5   Q. What routes do you support?

 6   A. I do not support any of the proposed routes through private property in the Hill

 7   Country but instead support dispatchable energy generation directly within the Permian

 8   Basin area.

 9   Q. Have you ever testified at the Public Utility Commission of Texas before?

10   A. No.

11   Q. Was this material prepared by you or under your supervision?

12   A. Material was prepared by myself.

13

14                         PROPERTY DESCRIPTION AND HISTORY

15   Q. Can you please describe the affected property, including the legal description

16   from the County CAD?

17   A. CAD # 9330, Legal Description: ABST 183 THOMAS R ERWIN, ACRES 120.5,
18   CAD # 18934, Legal Description: ABST 183 THOMAS R ERWIN, ACRES 6.58

19   CAD # 9331, Legal Description: ABST 183 THOMAS R ERWIN, ACRES 1

20

                                                               Direct Testimony of Tracy Snell Mack
                                                                            PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                   SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                       Page 5 of 12
  1   Q. Can you please explain your history and familiarity with the affected property,

 2   including its current usage?

 3   A. My family has continuously ranched and stewarded this property through multi-

 4   generations since 1901. The property is currently used as a primary homestead and for

 5   raising cattle with a goal to continue preserving the land and its ecological heritage for

 6   wildlife, hunting, fishing, ranching and recreation for many generations to follow.

 7   Q. Can you please include any pictures with dates that depict the property and

 8   how it is used?

 9   A. Yes, Pictures are attached and labeled below.

10   Q. Have the pictures been altered?

11   A. No.

12   Q. Do the pictures accurately represent the views of the property?

13   A. Yes.

14   Q. Are there any habitable structures on your property? And if so, how many?

15   A. Yes, there are (2) habitable structures.

16

17

18

19
                                                                Direct Testimony of Tracy Snell Mack
                                                                             PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                        Page 6 of 12
  1                IMPACT ON LAND USE AND ECONOMICS (PURA § 37.056)

 2   Q. How would the proposed transmission line interfere with your current land

 3   use?

 4   A. While the proposed route is not directly on our property, there is potential for

 5   environmental changes and disruption from transmission lines up-creek that concern

 6   me. The transmission line would be visible from the homestead back patio and up

 7   Sulphur Creek. The transmission line would be aesthetically unappealing for the

 8   majority of our property. We do not wish to see it at all from our property.

 9   Q. Are there any specific structures or features that would be within 500 feet of

10   any of the proposed routes?

11   A. No.

12   Q. In your opinion, how will this project affect the value of your land?

13   A. Although we have no intentions of ever selling the land, a transmission line would

14   permanently alter the current unobstructed view from the homestead looking up Sulphur

15   Creek. See photo (A) attached below.

16

17

18

19


                                                                Direct Testimony of Tracy Snell Mack
                                                                             PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                        Page 7 of 12
  1              ENVIRONMENTAL AND CULTURAL IMPACTS (16 TAC § 25.101)

 2   Q. What are your concerns regarding the local environment and wildlife?

 3   A. It is my belief that transmission lines would significantly impact, disrupt and/or

 4   destroy local native wildlife, habitats, migratory patterns and natural water sources and

 5   their riparian systems potentially increasing further erosion and/or flood risks. Noise

 6   pollution from transmission activity could negatively affect not only human quality of life,

 7   but also the surrounding wildlife.

 8   Q. Are there any additional cultural or historic details about your property we

 9   should be aware of?

10   A. Yes, historic Thornal-Cemetery (2 sites) dated 1878-1900 is located on property. This

11   cemetery is recognized by the Texas Historic Commission. See photo (B) attached

12   below.

13                          LOCAL NEED AND COST (PURA § 37.056)

14   Q. Do you believe this project provides a direct benefit to your local electric

15   service?

16   A. No.

17   Q. Do you believe this project will decrease your electric cost?

18   A. No, I believe it will increase Texan’s electric cost with no local benefits.

19


                                                                  Direct Testimony of Tracy Snell Mack
                                                                               PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                      SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                          Page 8 of 12
  1                          RECREATION AND COMMUNITY VALUES

 2   Q. How would this transmission line affect your enjoyment of your property?

 3   A. The transmission line would permanently alter the rural, peaceful, and quiet

 4   homestead surroundings as well as the unique native landscape and ecosystem.

 5   Q. How would this transmission line affect your rural community values for your

 6   area?

 7   A. Transmission lines would potentially negatively affect property values and

 8   landowner’s ability to utilize their land as they see fit.

 9

10                          CONCLUSIONS AND RECOMMENDATION

11   Q. What is your recommendation to the Commission?

12   A. Alternative and less destructive options should be considered such as generating

13   power directly from the Permian Basin. I request all regulatory affiliates to conduct full

14   extensive review, analysis and studies on the entire route and that all findings be

15   meticulously considered and presented before proceeding with any decision. If you are

16   unable to deny the project all together, I strongly request you reconsider any and all

17   routes that include link U1 for the reasons stated above.

18   In conclusion: Our family has worked for 125 years preserving our land for wildlife,

19   hunting, ranching, and farming with the continuous goal of being good stewards of the



                                                                  Direct Testimony of Tracy Snell Mack
                                                                               PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                      SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                          Page 9 of 12
 1   land for many generations to follow. I can confirm that this project does not fit our family

2   values and would be detrimental both personally and environmentally.
